title: Word Frequency
constraints: Input is provided as words.txt in the working directory.
Output each count and word separated by a space, sorted by descending frequency.
Write a bash pipeline in the editor (use JavaScript language slot).

examples.input: the day is sunny the the

solutionApproaches.title: Unix Pipeline
solutionApproaches.explanation: tr splits words to lines, sort groups them, uniq -c counts, sort -rn sorts descending, awk formats output.
